title: research.md
content: Research            /              Publications            /              Instruments            /              Software                                                  Team            /              Gallery            /              News            /              Contact                                                                                            RESEARCH                                                                                  01                                                                                                              LSPR                                      Localized Surface Plasmon Resonance                                      Plasmonically active nanostructures are used to investigate              light–matter interactions at the nanoscale.                                                                                  02                                                                                                              SERS                                      Surface-enhanced Raman Spectroscopy                                      Plasmonic nanostructures are developed to enhance Raman              scattering at confined nanogaps.                                                                                  03                                                                                                              TERS                                      Tip-enhanced Raman Spectroscopy                                      AFM or STM is combined with Raman spectroscopy to investigate              surface chemistry with nanoscale spatial resolution.                                                                              APPLICATIONS                                                                                      01                                                                                                              High-resolution in situ Chemistry                                      Observe interesting chemical reactions under working              environments with nanoscale spatial resolution.                                      Ref.:              J. Am. Chem. Soc.              2018, 140, 18, 5948–5954                                                                                  02                                                                                                              Single-molecule Dynamics                                      Highly sensitive optical measurements reveal new chemical              dynamics at the single-molecule limit.                                                                                  03                                                                                                              Photochemistry                                      Studying plasmonic nanostructures to trigger and track              interesting photochemical reactions.                                                                                  04                                                                                                              Electrochemistry                                      Electrochemical reactions at the electrode interface are              investigated with single-molecule sensitivity or nanoscale              spatial resolution.                                                                                  05                                                                                                              Optical sensor/devices                                      Development of chemical and biological sensors with high              chemical sensitivity and selectivity.                                                                                  06                                                                                                              Modelling                                      Optical modelling of molecules using time-dependent              density functional theory (TD-DFT).                                      Ref.:              J. Am. Chem. Soc.              2020, 142, 23, 10446–10458                                                        404, Natural Science Building #3, 1 Kangwondaehak-gil, Chuncheon, kangwon 24341, Republic of Korea                      Phone:        +82 (0)33-250-8487            |              Email:        gkang@kangwon.ac.kr
